name: check_room
description: Checks whether the campus room is free for a requested time slot. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440, so 10:00 is 600 and 24:00 is 1440. It only answers Available or Unavailable and never saves or creates a booking.

start.description: Requested start, whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600)

end.description: Requested end, whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440)

now.description: Current time, whole minutes since midnight

blocked.description: True when the room is blocked, false otherwise

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room, may be empty

start.description: Booking start in minutes since midnight

end.description: Booking end in minutes since midnight
